reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and I actually read labels. A named independent lab with a report for each batch, glycinate and no oxide is what I look for, so I would try one box at the $24.99 launch price.
objection: It is a brand with no reviews yet, and 30 foil sachets plus a box is a lot of packaging waste for something I could take from one bottle. I would open the lab report first and check that it matches the label.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the product page was missing, did not name the lab, or did not match the 200 mg on the label, I would not buy. Real customer reviews and a refill option without the sachets would make me buy a second box.
